About
Background

I'm a mechanical engineer who loves building things — from sensor-integrated medical braces to model jet engines, and robotic linkage systems. I studied at The Cooper Union, where I developed a broad technical skillset spanning fabrication, simulation, and design.

Outside the lab I work as a bartender at a Michelin-star restaurant, where I am able to connect with people from all over the world and work in a high-pressure, collaberative work enviorment. I thrive at the intersection of craft, rigor, and creativity.
